references.text: The same chapter earlier describes the same sacrifices to be brought on the eighth day for cleansing, including the two lambs and the grain offerings that are to be brought to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
Similar instruction to bring a sacrifice to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting before the Lord in connection with cleansing.
Parallel text about bringing an offering on the eighth day to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
A similar cleansing ritual where an offering is brought to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting before the Lord.
Describes that an offering must be brought at the entrance of the tent of meeting before the Lord.
Refers to bringing sacrificial animals to the entrance of the tent of meeting before the Lord.
Reference to the entrance of the tent of meeting (ohel moed) as a holy place of assembly.
Similar instruction to bring an offering on the eighth day to the priest at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
